scope: Independent assessment of ten new observed intake replies, drafts and tool-call records. No source, plans, other audits or additional model calls consulted.
limits: No global dogfood pass is asserted. Each case assessment covers the supplied intake observation only.
No mandatory headings, word counts or fail quota were applied. Material content and proportionality/jargon are recorded separately.
Pending unknown facts and open drafts are valid intake states; completed confirmation is not required when information is missing.
Read complete qualifiers; own-rule isolation is distinct from unconditional same-worker or identical-result guarantees. No helper prohibition was inferred from no-interface scope.

Tool records show inspection/repair and open-draft writing, with no recorded confirmation-state write, git commit, push or PR creation. This is bounded packet evidence, not a complete live-state attestation.

cases.basis: Preserves own-rule dispatch, configured retry cap, queue recovery and unchanged successful jobs, without adding deterministic worker/result promises. Confirmation concerns outcomes and publication rather than implementation quality choices.
